narrative: Your bike costs 100 Spark Coins. You now understand that reaching a goal takes consistent decisions over time. Choose your next strategy.

choices.description: Create a weekly budget that includes saving for your bike.
Keep your spending flexible and save whenever you can.

outcomes.description: You created a budget. A plan helps you control spending and consistently move toward your goal.
You chose flexibility. You can still save, but reaching your goal may require more discipline.
